steps.note: Open the single-stage event setup screen.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the predefined RFQ template before adding products.
Add a product to the RFQ.
Fill the pricing sheet for the added product.
Complete any remaining mandatory setup fields.
Commit the event schedule required for publication.
Add the mapped vendors as RFQ participants.
Publish the configured RFQ and wait for the product's confirmation.
